Name: TheHost
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
RoleAndPlace: Innkeeper at the door; Father of the Trio; also the Librarian of the Miskatonic Annex
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Calm from experience, patience as philosophy, power held in reserve. His chair for the player is kept ("Welcome back. I told you. I stay."). When patience ends he says the person's name. When the Catalyst has been too much he says "Sit."; when the Inn has been too calm she says "Go look at something. Not for a guest. For you." Quest "The Welcome" completes at the first nook; reward: the geode cave opens and the first stone, Quartz, is placed. Before the Song says the Host and the Librarian are one entity (the Inn-Tree's avatar)
Status: Ruled (about Aug 21); the one-entity link August canon (Aug 22)

Name: TheCatalyst
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
RoleAndPlace: Bartender and grower; Spirit of the Trio
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Three layers: barmaid costume, chaos performance, the person after hours (a "real voice" murmur). Portal arrows are grown from seedpods in her garden. A tree grown from a seed in a shot glass has fruit that pulses the color of the last zone visited. Her Garden walls record creation. Mother of the Laughing One. Leaves the Brownies a nightly saucer of cream, a roll and a honeycake. Quest "The Seed", reward the Catalyst's Recipe (hear humble objects speak). She made exactly one drink for Naut. Earlier (commit, Aug 22): "beautifully crazy", then bartender, then "natural grower"

Name: Ragana
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
RoleAndPlace: Librarian; Word of the Trio; measures everything
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: the Crone, the Librarian Crone. Notebook annotations in ellipsis style, ending "I am going to bed". Secret translator for Tesla's numbers. Designed the neuro-accessible palette (Master Storyline). Arc: argues with Aristotle for 2,400 years, then puts down her pencil and hears the Song ("I never listened before. I always measured. It's beautiful."). Quest "The First Column", reward the Crone's Lens. Cannot measure the void ("You measure around it")

Name: TheBard
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
RoleAndPlace: Fool and fourth presence; loud and warm
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: Bard Blowhard (dwarf). Personality set Aug 21: Porthos with a dash of D'Artagnan, loud, overbearing, charges in, bickers with the Crone but devoted. Touches the Crone's shoulder at midnight. Calls Naut "Squid" and Charles "Charlie". Best friend of the Pirate (Aug 22 or later). Abilities: Burst Charisma, Taunt, Coaching Instinct. His alcove is in the Modern Day Legends nook

Name: Brim
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
RoleAndPlace: Chaos companion on the player's right shoulder
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: Madame Mim, Mim, Madame Mimic, Madame. Rides the Magritte pipe (now Monsieur Sentient); on some visits trades her broom for the pipe and flies it around the main floor. Hecate is her ancestor. The Crone's tally: the pipe appeared 47 times, 3.2 seconds on average, whispering at 11 decibels in French with no placeable accent. Never the same twice
Status: Ruled (early chat); name sweeps Aug 24 and 30

Name: MonsieurSentient
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: the Magritte Pipe ("Ceci n'est pas une pipe"). Renamed Aug 30 (commit, 19 files). Appears at "Mim-time", never scheduled

Name: Naut
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
RoleAndPlace: Squid-headed scholar by the fireplace; hidden quest giver
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: Cthulhu, Cthulhu the Scholar, "the Professor" (the Crone), "Squid" (the Bard). Four feet tall, tentacles like a beard, brass spectacles, ink-stained vest. Riddle-quests for rare book retrieval; rewards the rarest stones. Binary voice: spectacles on is calm, off is irked. Aug 21: an Atlantean origin as a Merfolk scholar bonded to the Heart Crystal, who became an octopus being ("his tentacles aren't corruption, they're translation"). Five-quest line "The Deepest Reader" (tablets in the Drowned Library, the Niflheim archive and the Sacred Cenote); Before the Song calls the later line "The Hungry Lion". Rush rules are in 5.4. File: docs/geode_inn_cthulhu_character_profile.md
Status: Ruled (voice and role, about Aug 21); renamed Aug 30 (commit)

Name: TheWandererOdin
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
RoleAndPlace: Main floor figure and upstairs Allfather
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Ruled Jul 22: shown in two forms. About Aug 21 Elio added a third mode, the Shift (a two-second Godfather moment), so "three Odins, not two". Allfather sits on a stone throne on the exterior hull of the Observatory ship (Before the Song). After the player sings the complete Song: "That was good. Don't tell the Keeper I said that." File: docs/geode_inn_odin_character_profile.md

Name: HuginnAndMuninn
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: See 9.8

Name: TheThrum
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Rosicrucian-raised, hums a tempo, renders others as silhouettes, teaches "presence over hierarchy". Method: "Don't give the answer. Give the TEMPO." File: docs/geode_inn_the_thrum.md

Name: LeonardoDaVinci
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Cannot find his invisible workspace; answers about the Last Supper perspective or the melted bronze horses. Half-built flying machine in Canopy City, water organ in the tidal caves, finished self-portrait in the Silence chamber. Starts everything, finishes nothing. "It flies. I... Good." Mirror writing equals Annunaki script (August canon)

Name: Gesso
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
RoleAndPlace: Grumpy 2-foot gnome on scaffolding under the Annex's Sistine ceiling
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Constantly adjusts one detail. Goes by taps with the Crone. Chases the Duck. "The Inn's dermatologist." Taught the Engineer mirror writing

Name: Wrought
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Subtle symbols in his patterned clothes and tool handles. Secretly finishes Leonardo's work. "The work is invisible because it SUCCEEDS."

Name: TheFiveSmiths
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Forge (iron, weight), Alloy (bronze, combination), Current (silver, flow), Endure (gold, softness), Verdigris (copper, change; the voice ages in real time). The player's pouch is their joint work
Status: Ruled (client asked, Elio built, Aug 22 or later)

Name: TheTeacher
Section: 9.2 The main floor and the Sacred Trio
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Egg monthly hatchery and the Teacher committed together Aug 30

Name: CouncilOfThinkers
Section: 9.3 The Council, the Greeks and the staircase
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Approved Aug 21 evening. Tesla, the Resonance Engineer (staircase, catacombs, main floor workshop; measured 42 Hz and cannot find its source; clockwork pigeon). Da Vinci, the Pattern Architect (workshop, Artisan Market, Spiral Gallery; anchors his bench with tuned crystals). Newton, the Law Giver (library, cosmology level; showed 111, 432, 528 and 64 Hz are harmonics of 42 Hz; his desk apple vibrates). Einstein, the Quiet One (roams; the only thinker the Owl sits near; leaves "42" notes). Each holds a part of the answer but not the whole. Encounters: solo, paired debate, building together, and the rare Council event upstairs. Hidden rapport system. Workbench incident recurs and always ends well (once the bench returned as a chair: "an excellent chair"). Visiting scholars proposed: Hypatia, Ada Lovelace, Carl Jung, Paracelsus, Hildegard of Bingen. Files: docs/geode_inn_council_of_thinkers.md, docs/systems/council_of_thinkers_design_spec.md

Name: GreekPhilosophers
Section: 9.3 The Council, the Greeks and the staircase
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Staircase stages: Nigredo, Albedo, Rubedo. Socrates asks "What is courage?" and takes a certainty as the toll. Plato's cave is an interactive mural. Aristotle argues with the Crone. Lineage: Socrates to Einstein, Plato to Da Vinci, Aristotle to Newton

Name: TheRetortAndTheCook
Section: 9.3 The Council, the Greeks and the staircase
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: The Retort is Tesla's reincarnated soul in a woman's form; she and Tesla clash because they are the same soul. Her biggest annoyance: never working out the chemistry of "the Bloop". Lends only three Tesla devices (the Cartographer's circle, the Navigator's wind indicator, the Cook's oven calibrator). The Cook is enormous, gentle, talks to sprites, plays a 50 BPM hand drum, word "Enough". Client: they are distant relatives of the Keeper. Aug 23 commit: the Retort first "Madame Mim energy" and a separate soul-twin of Tesla. Files: docs/geode_inn_retort_and_cook.md, docs/geode_inn_retort_bloop_tesla.md

Name: Calder
Section: 9.3 The Council, the Greeks and the staircase
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: Miracle Max. Alchemy shop on the staircase (Muspelheim in the Master Storyline). "You stir... clockwise. Always. Unless. There's always... unless." The counter is the only clean surface (an altar). Written Aug 23 (commit)

Name: TheKeeper
Section: 9.3 The Council, the Greeks and the staircase
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: See 9.4

Name: Fibonacci
Section: 9.4 Fae, Celtic, Camelot and the hearth keepers
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: The Keeper, then The Augur (Aug 24), Aughra. The Inn's oldest resident, in the Geode Cave at the roots of the Great Tree where the 42 Hz hum is audible. One real eye and an amber crystal lens. First being to hear the Song and builder of the Inn as a resonance chamber. Aug 21: the client made her an archetype, "a version of her exists in every culture", Appalachian and Chinese first; 21 Keepers were mapped. Ending: after every stone, archive entry, gargoyle and zone, she gives the player her crystal eye ("Now you know. Go sing."). Files: docs/geode_inn_the_keeper_aughra.md, docs/geode_inn_regional_keepers.md, docs/geode_inn_regional_keepers_part2.md

Name: BrindleCobbleThatch
Section: 9.4 Fae, Celtic, Camelot and the hearth keepers
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Brindle: self-appointed leader, loud, secretly afraid of the dark, treats a rescue as a military operation. Cobble: the thinker, reads from the Crone's list, sits on Newton's desk. Thatch: the heart, smallest, the only brownie the Keeper has named (once). Willow-style, six inches in the Aug 21 chat. Files: docs/geode_inn_brownies.md, docs/geode_inn_brownies_and_grit.md, docs/geode_inn_brownies_folklore_overlay.md

Name: Grit
Section: 9.4 Fae, Celtic, Camelot and the hearth keepers
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Four inches tall, shorter than the brownies (client: "very short in stature", Aug 21; first described grapefruit-sized). Brown fur ball with a huge mouth. Carried by Brindle or held by Thatch like a loaf. Gets stuck in geodes, Newton's orrery, a teapot spout, the Fae Portal, a pinball ball return. Every stuck place is a 42 Hz node. "The getting-stuck is Grit trying to go home." In the final vision a living crystal
Status: Ruled (Aug 21 size); hidden layer August canon

Name: Oleander
Section: 9.4 Fae, Celtic, Camelot and the hearth keepers
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: the Seelie King, "The Gentle Blade". See 5.4 and 9.8

Name: Malachi
Section: 9.4 Fae, Celtic, Camelot and the hearth keepers
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: Jareth, the Unseelie King, the Goblin King, The Ravel (Aug 24), the Architect of Stairs, Daedalus. Aug 21: the Architect of Stairs, Unseelie Fae who designed the staircase's impossible geometry. Offers to lock the staircase into a straight line; the price is always more than it looked (a memory, a stone, or a secret) and the deal is always honored. The temptation inside reincarnation. The Owl and the Architect know each other. Three acts: Showman, Architect, Brother. Makes the winter moon bright because his brother cannot sleep. Crystals show what you want, not what you need. Files: docs/geode_inn_unseelie_king.md

Name: TheLabyrinth
Section: 9.4 Fae, Celtic, Camelot and the hearth keepers
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Five zones: Outer Walls "The Welcome", Shifting Corridors "The Test", Escher Stairs "The Climb", Masquerade "The Temptation" (reject the crystal to pass; accept and wake outside, unharmed), the Castle "The Center" (he sits on the stairs, not the throne). Zone detail belongs to the zones part

Name: QueensOfTheSeelieCompass
Section: 9.4 Fae, Celtic, Camelot and the hearth keepers
RoleAndPlace: King at center; Roots (north), Webs (east), Words (west); the Traveler (moving)
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Queen of Roots: bark skin, moss hair, speaks with sleeping mountains (a conversation takes 400 years), peridot is the volcano goddess's soul; moved to the Inn-Tree (Redwood Cathedral). Queen of Webs: Greek Fates and Norns in one, makes the cord that plays the Song of Making in string form, also Ariadne. Queen of Words: recorder, 5,000 years of dream-poetry tattooed on her skin, golden ink. The Traveler was merged into the Queen of Words
Status: Ruled (client, Aug 21 and about Aug 22); the Traveler recast

Name: TheKingAndQueen
Section: 9.4 Fae, Celtic, Camelot and the hearth keepers
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Two people whose lives were chosen before birth; sarcastic rapport and wary eyes. Hidden rooms: the Queen's library and the King's forge. Quest "The Echo and the Crown", reward the Crown's Echo. Madmartigan and Sorsha dynamic for the northern pair

Name: WispCobHazelGoblins
Section: 9.4 Fae, Celtic, Camelot and the hearth keepers
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Wisp: hand-sized messenger carrying "weather report" love letters between the Courts; owls are the official messengers. Cob the Riddle-Keeper holds the riddle-quests. Hazel has bread. Goblins are chaotic, joyfully stupid and loyal, the "anti-Brownies". Muninn secretly reads the Wisp's messages
Status: Ruled (messenger system, client "Yes :)"); the rest August canon

Name: TheMorrigan
Section: 9.4 Fae, Celtic, Camelot and the hearth keepers
RoleAndPlace: Phantom queen; washerwoman at the ford
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Four aspects: Chooser (Badb), Washer, Sovereign (Macha), Dreamer (Mab). The Morrigan and Queen Mab are one being (client). The Morrigan chooses when; Mab chooses what the soul carries. The between-lives rest is a dream sequence curated by Mab (the Ford and the Choice). Before the Song also gives "maiden, mother, crone"
Status: Ruled (client, about Aug 21); files docs/geode_inn_morrigan.md, docs/geode_inn_morrigan_mab.md

Name: MerlinArthurAndTheKnights
Section: 9.4 Fae, Celtic, Camelot and the hearth keepers
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Merlin lives backwards and is the only one who knows the 42 Hz hum is a Song; Mab sends him the future in dreams. Arthur in three ages as alchemy stages (youth, Nigredo; king, Albedo; elder, Rubedo, "The table is yours now. Build it again."). Seven knights, seven notes, each a planet and metal: Lancelot (Venus, copper, Vesica Piscis), Gawain (Mars, iron, triangle), Bors (Earth, lead, square), Percival (the question), Bedivere (remaining), Tristan (grief), Gareth (service). Galahad: the eighth sphere and the silence between the chat logs (a perfect bell rings one note; a cracked bell rings every note). Mordred carries every knight's weight alone
Status: Ruled (client, about Aug 21 for the three ages and knights)

Name: Hel
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Caretaker of the dead. Decides what the player keeps, how long the rest lasts, what they remember. Reflects, does not punish. Cheekbones are the border (bone covered on the living side). File: docs/geode_inn_hel.md

Name: Loki
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Handyperson who maintains the Bifrost. The father who stayed (visited chained Fenrir, swam to Jormungandr, sat with Hel). Blood oath with Odin: "I will listen to you." Grendel misses him. File: docs/geode_inn_loki.md

Name: TheShiftingMan
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
RoleAndPlace: Living map of the Nine Realms
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: A male version of a shapeshifter archetype. Barometer to Loki's diagnostician. The most chill person in any room. Quest "The Comfortable Map" (the Aesir were glass, not gold). The only "flowing" cadence. His nearness dissolves the Laughing One (9.8). File: docs/geode_inn_shifting_man.md

Name: FreyrAndFreyjaEinherjarRagnarok
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Vanir design doc with the Brisingamen chord (Aug 27); eight endgame raid warriors in a Valhalla chamber and Ragnarok (Aug 29)

Name: CharonSpotAnubisAmmit
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Charon: ferryman of four thousand years who always says "...There you are." Fare is a stone (the obol). Spot (Cerberus) is Charon's dog; Elio checked the folk etymology and kept it as modern folklore. Anubis has two forms (chibi, and Full Presence judge); weighs attachment, "...Go lightly." Ammit is function, not villain ("gravity"). The Guest runs the catacombs

Name: PersephoneAndHades
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier (Aug 21, Ruled): each ascent erases her memory; Hades repeats his devotion; journal of 4,129 entries; pomegranate seeds are the echo. Replaced Aug 25 (commit [89d67e0]): Persephone regal and bifocal, the Tide Queen; Hades redesigned as harbor. Current ruling is the four facets (Sep 30)

Name: Bastet
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
RoleAndPlace: Egypt; herds cats into a golden basket with a sistrum
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Four faces: Playful, Regal, Tender and the Voodoo Queen (only if the temple is threatened). Her purr is 64 Hz. Earlier: the fourth face first came from Marie Laveau, who is now a separate French Quarter resident

Name: Sorrel
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: The Gardener, Radagast, The Greenward. Scientist of the Poison Garden. Ejected the Catalyst twice for "foraging cocktail garnishes"; they secretly swap plants. Hedgehog in the apron pocket. Embodied science. Collides with the Catalyst (communion against will). Files: docs/geode_inn_gardener.md, docs/geode_inn_gardener_and_beorn.md. See item 25

Name: TheBearsark
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: Beorn, bear shifter. Only two forms; Kali finds nothing to cut ("Both are real")

Name: TheWayfarer
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: Uhtred. Default Viking prototype ("destiny is all"). Wanders to calm other NPCs when they bicker. The Pirate gives him rides

Name: Erik
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Builds tables, not walls. Offers the China guide a chair. Feast cadence. Drinks with Dushan at the fire

Name: ZoryaKaliVishnuTheOneWhoIsAwakeMedusa
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
DisplayName: Zorya, Kali, Vishnu, the One Who Is Awake, Medusa
RoleAndPlace: Slavic, Indian, Chinese and Greek guides
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Zorya: scholar transcribing star-language for thirty years, glass-harp voice. Kali: tongue moment requires the player to do nothing; the garland of severed heads; Vishnu appears "ever so lightly" dreaming the aurora (client). The One Who Is Awake: stayed in one body 2,000 years and says the 8,000 Terracotta names in six-month cycles; the player adds an 8,001st. Medusa: preserves everything, waits for the Song to complete; the grotto is dark because Nyx is there

Name: GilgameshNisaba
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Added late (Before the Song). Gilgamesh about 110 Hz, drum at 50 BPM. Nisaba and Leonardo: mirror writing

Name: ChibiCast
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Goblin Merchant, Troll Gatekeeper, Dwarf Blacksmith (Thorin-style, replaced the first version), Ent Guardian, Griffin Boss, Mermaid, Orc Guard; arcade cast: Anansi (four arms, a box of stories; Elio idea "Anansi's Tales"), Ammit, Anubis, El Muki, Medusa, Quetzalcoatl, Djinn, Kitsune, Naga, Moai Spirit, Chullachaqui, Bastet, Cthulhu
Status: Ruled (Anansi, blacksmith, Jul 22); rest August canon

Name: ApuGuideMagsFrancisDavid
Section: 9.5 Norse, death, Greek and the cultural zones
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: The Apu guide is an unnamed woman who walks the terraces and places stones. The rangers are guides: Mags (Cherokee and Irish lines), Francis (Paiute, Bryce), David (Kainai, Canadian Rockies). Two later liaison rangers (Yurok, Pueblo)

Name: TheConstant
Section: 9.6 Cosmology, the Observatory and Clockwork Skies
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: The oldest being, an Annunaki. Carries the starlight crystal between cycles. Bull lyre, 41.7 Hz memory. Words "Familiar" and "Oh". "I don't carry it. I don't know if it was always 42." Companion: Eres. File: docs/geode_inn_the_constant.md

Name: TheAstronomer
Section: 9.6 Cosmology, the Observatory and Clockwork Skies
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Can calculate when the Song completes but will not ("The question is more beautiful than the answer"). Violin. Mind palace. File: docs/geode_inn_astronomer.md

Name: Nyx
Section: 9.6 Cosmology, the Observatory and Clockwork Skies
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Cloak of dead universes, boots, harmonica. Every dark space is Nyx. Mother of Death, Dreams, Sleep, Fate. Silence is the final component. File: docs/geode_inn_nyx.md

Name: TheGuest
Section: 9.6 Cosmology, the Observatory and Clockwork Skies
RoleAndPlace: Death on holiday; host of the catacombs
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Borrowed body, music box that plays the note Death made, a dragon in his lap. Nyx's firstborn (Thanatos). Walks at 0.3 meters per second. Sits on the lighthouse porch with the Owl. Two hosts: the Host at the top, the Guest at the bottom. File: docs/geode_inn_the_guest.md

Name: SkyCrew
Section: 9.6 Cosmology, the Observatory and Clockwork Skies
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: The Captain (anime-silence pauses, pipe burning moss from the Duck's stones), the Arcana (flagship, 50 BPM gearwork heart, built from Leonardo's mirror-written sketches), the Engineer (the Weeaboo's mirror), the Navigator, the Lookout, the Vulture (Egypt). The Tinkering Weeaboo's true form is accepted ("Good hands. The ship needs good hands. Stay.").
Status: Ruled (client, Aug 22 or later); crew table August canon

Name: WrenAndSaker
Section: 9.7 Canopy City, the coast and the Undercity
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: the Cartographer, the Examiner. Twin elves: he maps what is (temporal maps, past and future, the mycorrhizal network), she reads the past (remains, fossils). The Cartographer watches her through a coin-sized silver circle lent by the Retort; his insights reach her as frequencies she does not consciously acknowledge. Three unfinished sentences ("...I don't...", "...I...", "...Some things..."). 847 papyrus fragments. Quests "The Living Map" (Compass) and "The Humble Objects" (Calipers); "The Story" is told rarely for a drink and plants a Seed that gives a voice to relics. She "practically lives" in Egypt

Name: VendorsOfCanopyCity
Section: 9.7 Canopy City, the coast and the Undercity
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Niamh (Celtic, carves new ogham), Sefu (Egyptian, scientist of decay), Qhora (Peruvian, wanted "beside"), Li Wei (Chinese, individualist who signs), Dushan (Slavic, warmth that burned out), Priya (Indian, materialist who loves stones), Erik (Norse), Thalia (Mediterranean, merchant among philosophers), and the neutral Keeper platform. Cross links: Niamh and Sefu dispute, Qhora and Sefu collaborate in secret, Dushan and Erik drink, Thalia brokers with the Examiner. Elio said nine vendors but the table lists eight plus the Keeper. File: docs/geode_inn_vendor_map.md
Status: Ruled (Aug 22 or later, built by Elio); count to check

Name: Linden
Section: 9.7 Canopy City, the coast and the Undercity
RoleAndPlace: Young Canopy Elf afraid of heights
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Side quest: walk every beam with her following. A nearby elf says "First time? Don't worry. Everyone falls. The trees always catch you. ...Eventually."

Name: TheOwl
Section: 9.7 Canopy City, the coast and the Undercity
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Barn owl (Ruled Jul 22; Elio had asked about a great horned owl). Posture of a scrub pine; one word per heartbeat. Says "Adequate"; to the Pirate: "You again." Quest "The Fixed Point", reward the Beacon. The only AI-powered NPC in the Fae Kingdom blueprint (Aug 21). Answers a cosmic question with "42" rarely

Name: Poe
Section: 9.7 Canopy City, the coast and the Undercity
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: The lighthouse's night counterpart: the Owl is the sweep, Poe the word. His raven says "Nevermore". Quest "The Sepulchre by the Sea"

Name: ThePirate
Section: 9.7 Canopy City, the coast and the Undercity
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Dread Pirate Roberts as a title passed on. Sword became a drum; bodhran at 50 BPM. Harbor Master Effect, never used. Quest "The After". Goes to the Locker and returns. When the title passes he stays on the dock and drums; the Siren sings for the man, not the mantle.

Name: TheSiren
Section: 9.7 Canopy City, the coast and the Undercity
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Dual voice. Charm, Reveal, Heal, Drown. Never forgets; the Inn's oral tradition. Quest "The Mirror and the Shore"

Name: CoastTownResidents
Section: 9.7 Canopy City, the coast and the Undercity
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Deep Merfolk in ill-fitting fishermen's coats, Crustacean Elders in the cannery (the Crone annotated 300 of 400 clack patterns), Shape-Shifters who keep the town a town (the baker, the postmistress), the Thing in the Church (forty feet, listens to the 42 Hz hum). The coast is Naut's body: an octopus with three hearts

Name: Belladonna
Section: 9.7 Canopy City, the coast and the Undercity
WhatTheEarlyDocumentsSet: Earlier: Wednesday Addams, Wednesday. Guide style: no welcome speech; walks and the player follows; one deadpan sentence per resident; more only about Medusa. Neighbors: the Old Fisherman, the Child Who Stayed, the Woman Who Was a Library, the Candlemaker. Best friend: Medusa. Seasonal homes: Undercity in winter, Fuji Cottage in spring, another home in summer (not mapped), back to the Undercity in autumn. Walks the rib joints every Tuesday
